strategy_change: Attack the shared cursor/handshake premise through a complete authority-derived carriage matrix, not another isolated local patch

implementation.cursor_placement: Enforce cursor presence exactly for event envelopes: cursorless events and cursor-bearing non-events are rejected before callbacks or replay-state mutation. Empty, whitespace, and non-string cursor values remain parser-rejected.
implementation.handshake: Pre-ack cursorless invocation and valid-cursor event are independently covered; deferred handler work is flushed before absence assertions, followed by valid-ack event, handler result, and queued-control controls.
implementation.event_compatibility: Valid opaque event payloads and metadata/extras remain unchanged. Public types, schemas, authority, project configuration, dependency set, and suppression set are unchanged.
implementation.authority: Derived from spec/streaming/ws/bindings/typescript.md rule 2 and spec/streaming/ws/typespec/main.tsp WsOutboundFrameEnvelope; host-session event payload requirements remain owned by spec/host/session/typespec/main.tsp.
